name: Diagnose Destiny port
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; sshpass -e ssh -4 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -u
cd ~/Upload-Assistant-wastaken
echo sockets:
command -v ss >/dev/null && ss -ltnp || true
command -v lsof >/dev/null && lsof -nP -iTCP:12345 -sTCP:LISTEN || true
command -v fuser >/dev/null && fuser -v 12345/tcp || true
echo processes:
ps -ef | grep -E '[u]pload|[p]ython.*webui|[p]ython /Upload-Assistant' || true
echo container-state:
podman inspect upload-assistant-wastaken --format 'id={{.Id}} status={{.State.Status}} pid={{.State.Pid}} exit={{.State.ExitCode}} error={{.State.Error}}' || true
REMOTE
description: Find the process holding Destiny’s WebUI port and determine why the restarted container is failing.
